notes: Was in ops/leads.md as having no website; site found 2026-11-23. Read the homepage, beef pricing, hog pricing, shop and FAQ pages. 360-acre farm. Beef page says Angus cattle are pasture raised, graze in summer and winter on local hay, with year-round free choice Vitalix protein tubs; Verifier should weigh the protein tubs against the grass-finished category. Beef sold whole or half at $11.75/lb hanging, farm slaughtered mid-October to late November, processed at Bear Mountain Meats in Palmer where buyers pick up. Pork is pasture raised and supplemented with local Delta barley, milk, eggs and minerals; halves or wholes, taken to a custom processor or picked up at the farm. No phone on the site, email contact only. Quotes came from WebFetch extraction.
